annotations.annotation_text: The Twelve Jurors / Tavern Drinkers (Guinness): representing the chorus of public opinion, the twelve signs of the Zodiac, the Apostles, and the customers gossiping in HCE's Chapelizod pub.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp

annotations.annotation_text: The eternal fraternal dialectic between opposing sons Shem the Penman (the introvert, rebel, artist) and Shaun the Post (the materialist, orator, politician), embodied in "Brother".
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Norris, Margot. The Decentered Universe of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/decentereduniver0000norr

annotations.annotation_text: The nocturnal oneiric dimension (Dream): Joyce's exploration of the sleeping body, sensory deprivation, auditory distortions, and the somatic language of the collective unconscious.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349

annotations.annotation_text: The primal text / Mama Livia's Letter retrieved from the Boston dump by Biddy Doran the Hen (Letter), representing the genesis of writing, literature, and the archaeological decipherment of history.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Deane, Vincent, et al. The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. https://www.brepols.net

annotations.annotation_text: Mythological and folkloric archetype (Patrick): invoking the ancient Fianna cycle, heroic legends of Ireland, and the patron saints of early Celtic Christianity.
sources: MacKillop, James. Dictionary of Celtic Mythology. https://www.oxfordreference.com
